---
title: Connector contract
description: The MUST list every connectors/* package satisfies — typed clients, dry-run-aware writes, and budgets and action caps that are enforced, not advisory.
---

One package per external system (`hubspot`, `clay`, `salesforce`, …), named
`@paydirt/<system>`, workspace-internal until published. A connector package
**MUST** satisfy every item below — the [Governance](/docs/concepts/governance)
guardrails turned into the checklist a connector PR is reviewed against,
condensed from
[`connectors/README.md`](https://github.com/nika-loki/paydirt/blob/main/connectors/README.md).

## The MUST list

- [ ] **Wrap one external system with a typed client**, constructed with a
  `RunContext` from `@paydirt/core`. The context travels through every call —
  it is how dry-run state, budget, and caps reach the connector.
- [ ] **Take secrets from `process.env` only** — never logged, never CLI
  arguments, never in thrown-error text. No code path formats a secret value
  into a string; diagnostics accept key *names* only.
- [ ] **Make every write dry-run-aware.** With `ctx.dryRun` true, writes
  perform no network mutation and return `{ planned: … }`. **Reads always
  execute** — dry-run is a guard on mutations, not on visibility.
- [ ] **Meter billable calls** with `ctx.budget.charge(usd, reason)` and
  **count mutations** with `ctx.countAction(reason)`.
- [ ] **Ship offline unit tests** with a mocked `fetch`, plus a `.env.example`
  whose values are literally `replace-me`.
- [ ] **Declare `test` and `typecheck` scripts** — `pnpm test` at the repo root
  runs them.
- [ ] **Import `@paydirt/core` only.** Never from `workflows/`, never sideways
  into another connector.

<Callout type="info">
  Reads always execute; writes are dry-run-aware; budgets and action caps are
  enforced, not advisory.
</Callout>

## Enforced means enforced

The meter is not a suggestion — `@paydirt/core` throws when a limit is hit
(`packages/core/src/run-context.ts`):

- `ctx.budget.charge(usd, reason)` throws `BudgetExhaustedError` the moment a
  charge would push the run past `DAILY_BUDGET_USD`.
- `ctx.countAction(reason)` throws `ActionLimitError` on the action that would
  exceed `MAX_ACTIONS_PER_RUN`.
- `DRY_RUN` anything-but-literal-`"false"` is a dry run; the default is dry
  everywhere except production.

The dry-run write shape, in skeleton form:

```ts
const result = ctx.dryRun
  ? { planned: planFrom(records) }   // no network mutation
  : await client.write(records);
```

A connector that logs a value, skips the meter on a billable call, or performs
a network mutation in dry mode fails review — see the connector PR invariants
in the [design spec](https://github.com/nika-loki/paydirt/blob/main/docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-23-paydirt-monorepo-design.md)
and [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/nika-loki/paydirt/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
